decisions.reason: Although Product C received only a brief mention rather than its own page, three years of investment and the firm's tendency to persist with launched products make a near-term drop unlikely.
Presented on its own page and part of a visibly committed inclined-lift line, Product D has high sunk costs and public commitment, so escalation makes dropping very unlikely.
Like Product D, Product E had its own page and belongs to the same strategic line, so the firm's public commitment and past investment support keeping it.
Despite being a truck-mounted variant, Product F also had its own page and is tied to the inclined-lift line, so escalation of commitment keeps the drop probability low.
